description: This file defines a PHP class 'HTMLPurifier_HTMLModule_Proprietary' which extends 'HTMLPurifier_HTMLModule' and adds support for proprietary HTML tags and attributes, specifically defining a 'marquee' element with various attributes.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_HTMLModule_Proprietary
classes.description: A class for defining proprietary HTML tags and attributes, disables standards compliance when enabled.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Configures the module by adding a 'marquee' element with its attributes.
